funFacts: Rolex Shanghai Masters runs 7 to 18 October. Prize fund 9,415,725 dollars.
Ten first-round matches were complete on 7 October. The round is not closed.
Djokovic beat de Minaur in the China Open final. Alcaraz beat Lehecka in the Japan Open final. Neither has played in Shanghai.

keyPlayers.name: Novak Djokovic
keyPlayers.hook: Beat Alex de Minaur 7-6 (3), 0-1 retired in Beijing on 6 October. Shanghai bye, no match yet.

keyPlayers.name: Carlos Alcaraz
keyPlayers.hook: Beat Jiri Lehecka 7-6 (4), 6-4 in Tokyo on 6 October. Shanghai bye, no match yet.

headline: Shanghai Masters: first round still open after ten Wednesday results
whyCareReason: Altmaier beat Rune, Fery beat Cilic, and eight other first-round matches are final. Zverev, Alcaraz and Djokovic have byes and have not played.
teaser: Not round 2. The round of 128 is underway. Beijing and Tokyo titles are already in the book.
story: TennisDB lists ten completed Shanghai first-round matches on 7 October, including Daniel Altmaier over Holger Rune and Arthur Fery over Marin Cilic. The official draw gives byes to the top seeds. Alexander Zverev, Carlos Alcaraz and Novak Djokovic have not played in Shanghai. Djokovic's Beijing final and Alcaraz's Tokyo final were on 6 October and are separate tournaments.
stakes: A Masters 1000 is in its first round. Do not print a round-of-64 result.
rivalryAngle: The seeds meet the winners of the round of 128. Those matches are not final.
